title: Liabilities
subtitle: Equity and intercompany current accounts, with balances derived from allocated transactions.

equity.title: New equity position
equity.description: Equity issued by the current organization. The position becomes an allocatable target in the Reconciliation tab.

loan.title: New current account
loan.description: Shareholder current account between two organizations. Its balance is derived from the transactions allocated to it.

debt.title: New bank loan
debt.description: The contract terms. The schedule and the outstanding capital are computed — never entered.
debt.revolvingHint: A revolving credit has neither duration nor schedule: the drawn amount is entered and corrected by hand.

errors.failed: The action failed. Please try again.
errors.already_matched_to_deal: This transaction is already matched to a deal. Unmatch it first.
errors.invalid_amount: The amount must be greater than zero.
errors.ambiguous_holder: Pick either an organization or a free-text label, not both.
errors.same_org: The creditor and the debtor must be two different organizations.
errors.not_a_party: You must be a member of at least one of the two organizations of the current account.
errors.has_allocations: Transactions are still allocated to this line. Detach them first.
errors.missing_duration: An amortizing loan needs a duration.
errors.deferral_too_long: The deferral must be shorter than the loan duration.
errors.limit_below_outstanding: The ceiling cannot be below the drawn amount.
errors.account_wrong_org: This bank account belongs to another organization.
errors.rate_is_fixed: This loan has a fixed rate: there is no revision to enter.
errors.has_documents: Documents are still attached to this row. Detach them first.
errors.missing_anchor: This document must be attached to a company, a deal or a loan.

loan.title: Edit current account
loan.description: The creditor and debtor cannot be changed — delete and recreate the account instead.

debt.title: Correct the loan
debt.description: Correcting overwrites the terms and recomputes the whole schedule. For a variable-rate revision, add a rate step instead.

delete.confirmBody: Deletion is refused while transactions are still allocated to it — detach them first.
delete.debtConfirmBody: Deletion is refused while documents or transactions are still attached — detach them first.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.empty: The terms entered cannot produce a schedule.
schedule.revolvingBody: A revolving credit has no schedule: only the interest on the drawn amount is projected.
schedule.insuranceNote: Insurance sits outside the instalment: the actual direct debit is instalment + insurance.

rates.title: Rate
rates.empty: No revision entered — the rate at signature applies.
rates.dialogDescription: A revision that happened, or a steering assumption. Instalments past the last actual revision are flagged as projected.

documents.title: Documents
documents.empty: No document attached to this loan.
